payload.core_mechanism_summary: Recursive DP with memoization to choose minimal number of bottles whose total capacity >= total soda, minimizing poured amount (time). State: (index, remaining_capacity_needed).
payload.rationale: The solution defines a recursive function calc(i, total) and uses a dictionary for memoization on both i and total parameter, characteristic of dp_memoized_recursion. It is not a 1D state DP.
